zh.summary: 罗宾汉报告了第二季度创纪录的收益，其中预测市场收益随着市场波动推动交易活动增加而激增十倍，投资者对投机交易的兴趣也大幅上升。

title: Chipotle lifts its sales forecast even as a lettuce-linked outbreak slows foot traffic
summary: Despite acknowledging softening customer traffic in late July due to a food safety incident linked to lettuce, Chipotle raised its full-year sales forecast, signaling confidence in operational recovery.
content: Mexican fast-casual chain acknowledged ‘softening’ traffic in the second half of July, but it’s taking a rosier view of its full-year prospects.

zh.title: 尽管生菜疫情放缓客流，Chipotle仍然上调销售预测
zh.summary: 尽管Chipotle承认由于与生菜相关的食品安全事件导致七月下旬的客流下降，但该公司仍上调了全年销售预测，表明其对运营恢复的信心。

title: SpaceX faces House Energy Committee demand to tour its AI data centers in Memphis
summary: The House Committee on Energy is demanding SpaceX provide records and grant facility tours of its AI data centers and power plants near Memphis, reflecting congressional scrutiny of private space company infrastructure operations.
content: The ranking member of the House Committee on Energy is demanding SpaceX records and a tour of its data centers and power plants in and around Memphis.

zh.title: SpaceX面临众议院能源委员会要求参观其孟菲斯AI数据中心
zh.summary: 众议院能源委员会要求SpaceX提供记录并允许参观其孟菲斯附近的AI数据中心和电站，反映了国会对私营太空公司基础设施运营的审查。

title: Your burger costs more this summer, but farmers say they're not cashing in
summary: Consumer prices for beef, bread, and salad have surged over the past year, increasing costs at restaurants and for consumers, yet farmers report they are not seeing proportional income gains from these higher retail prices.
content: The prices of beef, bread buns and bagged salad have risen sharply over the past year, figures show.

zh.title: 你的汉堡今年夏天更贵了，但农民说他们没有获利
zh.summary: 过去一年消费者对牛肉、面包和沙拉的价格大幅上升，导致餐厅和消费者的成本增加，但农民报告他们没有从这些更高的零售价格中获得相应的收入增长。
